svg.title: What the vector file holds
svg.desc: Counts per section: 21 tree hashes, 210 inclusion proofs, 210 consistency proofs, 567 subtree consistency proofs, 10 covering cases, 11 validity cases, 15 tile paths (8 of them invalid), 6 layouts, 2 node mappings, 4 Appendix C hashes, 5 relative OIDs, 2 cosigned messages, 1 MTCProof, 1 landmark-relative certificate, 1 checkpoint body, 1 key ID.

text.tspan: the four Appendix C hashes each stand for thousands of proofs: one line per case, one running SHA-256.
